method: Empirical CDF, all seasons and directions; annual maxima are observations, not return levels.

directional_extremes.method: Annual maximum within each directional sector in each complete UTC calendar year; stationary independent annual maxima; Gumbel MLE; percentile bootstrap resampling years.
directional_extremes.sampling_note: Only complete hourly calendar years with valid Hs and direction (direction may be missing for calm Hs=0) are used. No-event years are not silently removed.
